MVP Developer (contract, 3 months)

Company: FinEdge (YC-backed, US)

We need one contractor to ship an internal MVP for a fintech product.

- Django or FastAPI backend, TypeScript/React frontend
- Postgres; Stripe webhooks; basic auth (Clerk or Auth0)
- Deploy on AWS (ECS); basic CI
- Ship weekly demos to the team

Contract: B2B, 30 h/week, $3,000 per month x 3 months
Remote: US-friendly, 4h overlap with EST
AI tools: allowed and encouraged
Application: founder@finedge.example
notes: F archetype; profile's full-stack backend experience (exp.acme) maps well; Django is not in the profile -> G4 coverage must list it as uncoverable, not fabricated.
